strings.text: The ruins of the Old People
We were told God had punished them for their pride.
strings.translation: Man sagte uns, Gott habe sie für ihren Hochmut gestraft.

strings.text: We were not allowed to come here. We came.
strings.translation: Wir durften nicht herkommen. Wir kamen.

strings.text: Sophie stroked the rusty side — warm from the sun.
strings.translation: Sophie strich über die rostige Flanke – warm von der Sonne.
